summary: An announcement from Steve Bunch that the next Network Graphics Working Group meeting might be held at the University of Illinois on May 11, 1973, with a final date to follow. It also invites anyone with comments on higher-level graphics protocols to write them up as RFCs beforehand. It updates RFC 396.

sections.title: The Meeting Proposal
sections.content:
This is a plain announcement from Steve Bunch of ILL-ANTS to the Network Graphics Group. Ira Cotton of NBS has proposed that Illinois host the next NGWG (Network Graphics Working Group) meeting in early May.

Bunch asks to hear of any pressing reasons not to schedule it for Friday, May 11, 1973. A formal announcement with local arrangements would follow in a week or two.
sections.eli5: Someone suggested a meeting date and asked if anybody could not come.

sections.title: Contact Details
sections.content: Replies could go by mail to the Center for Advanced Computation at the University of Illinois, Urbana, Illinois 61801, or by phone at (217) 333-9354, or 333-8150 if there is no answer. Bunch could also be reached on the network as BUNCH@USC-ISI.
sections.eli5: The note says where to send a letter, who to call, and how to message on the network.

sections.title: Call for RFCs
sections.content: Anyone with ideas, comments, suggestions or even derision for higher-level graphics protocols is asked to air them in an RFC before the meeting, so that everyone has time to think about them. The RFC updates RFC 396.
sections.eli5: Write your ideas down before the meeting so everyone can read them first.
